title: Hypergeometric Draw Odds
description:
An informational overlay that answers one question: what are the odds the hand you draw next turn contains the cards you care about?

During combat, press W or use the ALL pile button beside Draw to open the main screen. It lays every card the next hand could reach into one grid, in draw order, beside a shelf built from the game's own Card Library.

- Click cards to select them, then set how many of them you need. One asks for any of them; the full count asks for every one.
- Hover any card for the chance of drawing an identical copy, and the chance of drawing that exact physical card.
- Show Odds on Cards prints the chances onto the cards themselves.
- Search the grid by card name, by description text, or by rarity.
- Rawdog Mode swaps the shelf for a plain hypergeometric calculator: deck size, draw size, hits in deck, hits wanted, reporting exactly, at least, at most, and the expected number of hits.

The odds follow the game's real draw order. The draw pile is consumed first; your discard pile and your hand return together on the reshuffle, so they are treated as one population. Cards a retain effect holds in hand are excluded, because they are not reshuffled until they are played and leave your hand.

The draw count is predicted for the turn that is coming, not the one in progress. Ring of the Snake, Bag of Preparation, Pocketwatch, Ring of the Drake, Pollinous Core, Pendulum, Draw Cards Next Turn and the rest are each read as the game will read them next turn, and the shelf names whichever of them moved the number.

The shortcut is rebindable in Settings > Input, and the screen can be navigated with a controller. Settings > Mod Settings offers an option to point the Draw Pile button at this screen instead.

Purely informational: it changes no gameplay and declares affects_gameplay false.
changeNote: First private build. Testing cross-platform loading.
